name: Native SQLite Memory

limits.temporalFacts: Proposal-gated fact/entity/edge/episode tables with validFrom, validUntil, supersededBy, episode provenance, and FTS5 fact index
limits.hybridRetrieval: FTS5, entity-edge graph expansion, and temporal ranking; semantic sqlite-vec signal is skipped when no local embedder is available
limits.extraction: Deterministic offline triple extraction writes proposals to the queue only; no active memory is created
limits.proposalQueue: SQLite table with idempotent fingerprints, leases, retries, and poison records
limits.filesystemReports: Generated workspace-local reports only; files are not canonical memory authority

notes: Uses Node 22 node:sqlite, which is experimental in Node 22.
Permanent writes remain governed by memory-core before this provider is called.
Temporal fact writes require an applied proposal queue record and supersede contradictory facts instead of deleting them.
Hybrid retrieval is local-only and does not call network or model APIs; semantic ranking is disabled unless a future local embedder/sqlite-vec path is present.
Offline extraction is deliberately heuristic and ADD-only; it enqueues reviewable proposals and never activates memory.
